name: agent-detect
description: Rule-based detection of AI agents vs humans for banks and other sensitive web apps: browser collector + server-side scoring, no ML model.

scripts.build: esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=AgentDetect --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/agent-detect.iife.js && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/agent-detect.esm.js && esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
